thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: HIGH error rate detected on /v1/completions across multiple regions. Aggregated 5xx and 429 spike starting 2026-03-12T15:09:03Z, p95 latency > 6s. Pager sent to @oncall-alex and @sam. Logs: ERROR gateway 502 upstream timeout id=bd3f4a tenant=acme route=/v1/completions latency_ms=12000
oncall-alex: on it. paging in eng-sre. tagging this with P0. collecting traces and rates now. any immediate customer-impact reports?
oncall-alex: initial hypothesis: global rate-limiter rolled out new quota-scope change at 15:02 UTC that might have reclassified shared token buckets -> tenant-level zeroing. this could cause a cascade of 429s and then 5xx from overloaded backends.
sam: I see the same in the traces — many 429s from the gateway followed by retries hitting the backend which times out. request volumes unchanged. full spike aligned with deploy-id: deploy/rl-quota-v2 @ 15:01 UTC.
jordan: pulling the deploy. checking rollout status on prod gateway and rate-limiter configs.
maya: adding quick metrics: global 429s -> 12x baseline, 5xx -> 5x baseline, tail latency p99 -> 22s. customer-impact: some streaming sessions truncated, a few enterprise customers reported 50% request failures.
li: heads-up: we have CS escalations from two large tenants (Acme, PeakSaaS). CSM @csm-eric is sending holding message. need ETA for mitigation.
nina: support notes: ticket #INC-2480 from Acme - they see repeated 429 then 502. attached request ids. customers asking for rollback or fail-open.
sam: mitigation plan (short): 1) pause rl-quota-v2 rollout 2) revert rate-limiter scope change OR apply emergency whitelist for high-tier tenants 3) enable fallback routing to dedicated pool for heavy tenants 4) add retry-wallet/backoff at gateway (temporary) 5) monitor error reduction.
oncall-alex: executing step 1: marking deploy/rl-quota-v2 paused and stopping rollout. @jordan please confirm if the feature flag can be disabled immediately.
jordan: feature flag "rl_quota_scope_v2" turned off at 15:16:08 UTC. rollout pause acknowledged.
ops-bot: [15:16:09] action: feature_flag_toggle rl_quota_scope_v2 -> OFF by jordan
sam: stepping through step 2: applying emergency per-tenant whitelist for top 50 tenants so they bypass the new global quota enforcement. command: 
```
runbook apply --name emergency-tenant-whitelist --tenants @top50 --scope gateway
```
started at 15:17 UTC.
oncall-alex: good. also spin up two extra gateway replicas and bump proxy timeouts (temp). jordan run the kubectl commands.
jordan: running: 
```
kubectl scale deploy/gateway --replicas=10 -n prod
kubectl patch deploy/gateway -n prod --patch '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"gateway","env":[{"name":"PROXY_TIMEOUT_MS","value":"30000"}]}]}}}}'
```
scaling started, should be hot in ~90s.
maya: after whitelist applied and FF turned off: observed 40% reduction in 429s within 60s, backend 502s trending down. p95 latency down to 3.1s. still above baseline.
sam: follow-up: for tenants still failing, enable route-level fallback to dedicated inference pool. adding routing rule now.
li: comms: @csm-eric please send interim message: "We're aware of elevated errors and have paused the quota rollout. We're applying emergency workarounds and will update in 30m."
csm-typo-fix: (typo) -- meant @csm-eric
csm-eric: message sent to Acme and PeakSaaS. requested logs and example request ids to assist debugging.
oncall-alex: quick ask — any sign of DB or KMS being hammered (which might cause 5xx)?
sam: no abnormal DB spikes. it's strongly consistent with rate-limiter behavior and subsequent retry pressure.
jordan: rollout metadata shows a config mismatch: policy 'scope=global' intended but deployed as 'scope=tenant' due to templating bug in helm chart. that caused token bucket keys to collide and most tenants hit shared bucket limits.
oncall-alex: ok root cause seems to be templating bug; immediate next steps: 1) keep FF off, 2) revert helm chart to previous template, 3) run a tighter canary when reapplying any changes.
sam: rolling back chart to release 2026-03-11-rc3 now. command: 
```
helm rollback rate-limiter 2026-03-11-rc3 --namespace=infra
```
rollback applied at 15:25 UTC.
ops-bot: [15:25:11] action: helm rollback rate-limiter -> 2026-03-11-rc3 by sam
maya: metrics post-rollback: total 429s down to 1.6x baseline, 5xx to 1.2x baseline after 2 minutes. streaming restore success rate improving.
li: recommend scheduled incident update at +30 and +90 minutes. prepare digest for customer comms.
oncall-alex: agreed. @nina compile support tickets list and impacted tenant names. include severity and last seen timestamp.
nina: compiling — Acme (sev1), PeakSaaS (sev1), SmallApp (sev2), Internal QA (sev2). ETA for full recovery estimate 45-60m.
sam: post-mortem notes to capture: templating bug in helm chart, insufficient unit tests around quota key formatting, lack of feature-flag guardrails for rollout, no canary limit on initial percentage. Also add automated smoke test to validate quota keys after deploy.
jordan: follow-up action — add a CI check that renders helm values and validates 'scope' field against expected enumeration. I'll add a ticket.
li: ops followups: consider rate-limiter circuit breaker to fail-open if global error rates spike after deploy. that's a product/security tradeoff but needed for mitigation.
oncall-alex: final: system is stabilizing. will keep watchers for next 2 hours. setting postmortem owners: sam (incident lead), jordan (deploy fixes), maya (metrics), li (customer comms), nina (support follow-ups).
incident-bot: incident resolved -> Major incident cleared at 15:37:35 UTC. summary: misapplied quota scope in rl-quota-v2 deploy caused shared token-bucket collisions -> 429 spike -> retry storm -> backend 5xx. mitigations: paused FF, whitelist for top tenants, scaled gateways, rollback helm chart, routing fallbacks. next steps: postmortem, CI checks, canary policy updates.
oncall-alex: thanks team. great rapid response. :tada:
